ENTITY_ID='PA4909648' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' (UPDATED) .
ENTITY_ID='PA2002418' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' (DELETED) . 
ENTITY_ID='PA1311102' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' (UNCHANGED) .
ENTITY_ID='9999' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT' (NEW RECORD) . 

select ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_ENTITYINTEREST WHERE  ENTITY_ID='PA4909648' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT'
UNION ALL
SELECT ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_ENTITYINTEREST WHERE ENTITY_ID='PA2002418' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT'
UNION ALL
SELECT ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_ENTITYINTEREST WHERE ENTITY_ID='PA1311102' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT'
UNION ALL
SELECT ENTITY_ID ENTITY_ID2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_ENTITYINTEREST WHERE ENTITY_ID='9999' AND ENTITY_TYPE='ACCNT') temp order by ENTITY_ID, SCD_START_DATE
